meaning_en: to surface, to emerge; to turn up, to show up (unexpectedly)
definition_de: aus dem Wasser an die Oberfläche kommen; übertragen: plötzlich erscheinen oder wiedergefunden werden (Er tauchte erst um Mitternacht auf. Mein Schlüssel ist wieder aufgetaucht.)
example_de: Plötzlich tauchte direkt neben unserem Boot ein riesiger Wal aus dem Wasser auf.
example_en: Suddenly a huge whale surfaced right next to our boat.
visual_idea: Collocation 'aus dem Wasser auftauchen': a whale breaks the surface right beside a small boat, water streaming off its back (auf- = up), and the tourists' amazement carries 'plötzlich'. It is the visual opposite of 'untertauchen' (boy going under). Rejected: 'plötzlich auftauchen' (a guest at the door reads as 'ankommen') and a found key (reads as 'finden'). Surfacing is a change, so a first+last-frame video starts with calm empty water.
image_prompt: view from slightly behind a small white whale-watching boat on a calm dark-blue sea, three tourists in red and yellow rain jackets at the railing on the left; right beside the boat a huge humpback whale has surfaced, its dark head and long back rising high out of the water, white water streaming off its skin, spray in the air; the tourists lean back with open mouths and amazed faces, grey coastal cliffs far away
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_start_prompt: view from slightly behind a small white whale-watching boat on a calm dark-blue sea, three tourists in red and yellow rain jackets at the railing on the left; on the right side of the boat the water surface is calm and empty with only small ripples; the tourists look out relaxed over the sea, grey coastal cliffs far away
video_prompt: from behind a small white boat on a calm sea, three tourists in red and yellow rain jackets look out over empty water; suddenly a huge humpback whale rises slowly out of the water right beside the boat, water streaming off its back, and the tourists lean back in amazement; static camera
